routes.label: a standard passport, lodged in Papua New Guinea

note: The passport fee of K100 is the one printed on Form FA 81 (Passport Act 1982; the copy read is the Embassy in Washington's, made in 2005) and the one the Deputy Prime Minister, minister for immigration, gave when the Lae office opened in December 2024. He also said an express fee of K300 brings the passport within 48 hours; whether that is paid on top of the K100 or instead of it is not said, so the express route's total is left unpaid until a source settles it. The standard processing time and the validity are leads: the Authority's website (ica.gov.pg) answers with a browser challenge and was not read.
